title: Inline muted seconds
description: Renders HH:MM:SS as one continuous mono time string, with the seconds set at mid-height (not subscripted) and only slightly smaller and muted, separated from the minutes by a thin, lighter-weight colon.

changes.intent: Expose seconds via toLocaleTimeString so the template can compose HH:MM:SS.
changes.detail: Add a `seconds` value derived with now.value.toLocaleTimeString('es-CR', { second: '2-digit' }), updated on the same tick as the existing time/date refs, returned from the composable.

changes.intent: Render a thin separator colon plus the seconds inline after HH:MM, mid-height rather than subscripted.
changes.detail: Inside .screen__clock-time, after the HH:MM text, add `:{{ seconds }}`, e.g. `22:40:07`.

changes.intent: Center-align the inline parts so the seconds sit at mid-height with the minutes rather than dropping to a subscript baseline.
A visually lighter separator distinguishing the seconds group from HH:MM without adding a new hue.
Slightly smaller than HH:MM but still legible and mid-height; muted (not faint) so it reads as a secondary but real value, not a decoration.
